## Summary

Describe the verified problem and the change.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added/updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Existing Community behavior remains functional.
- [ ] Termux/Android impact considered where relevant.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, customer data or private signing material were added.

## Public / commercial boundary

- [ ] This change belongs in the public Community/core repository, **or** it only adds a minimal public contract required for interoperability.
- [ ] It does not add a new proprietary Pro/Business implementation that should live in the private commercial repository.
- [ ] Security does not depend on hiding public verification code or wire formats.
- [ ] Any paid capability introduced here fails closed when no valid edition provider/entitlement is present.

See `docs/EDITION_BOUNDARY.md`.

## Upstream / licensing

- [ ] Inherited MIT notices remain intact.
- [ ] Third-party code/dependencies added by this PR have compatible licensing and attribution.
